description: This Java class implements a Redis-backed store for LwM2mClient objects, providing methods to get, put, retrieve all, and remove clients, with specific handling for Redis cluster connections and serialization/deserialization of client data.

classes.name: TbRedisLwM2MClientStore
classes.description: A class that manages LwM2mClient instances in Redis, supporting get, getAll, put, and remove operations with cluster support.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an LwM2mClient by endpoint from Redis, deserializing the stored data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all LwM2mClient instances stored in Redis, handling both cluster and non-cluster Redis setups.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores or updates an LwM2mClient in Redis, with validation on client state.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an LwM2mClient from Redis by endpoint.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates Redis key for a given endpoint.
